Shelley Funke Frommeyer highlights local campaigns and advocacy efforts in recent posts
Shelley Funke Frommeyer, a Kentucky State Senator, recently posted several updates on her social media account regarding upcoming community and political events.
On August 23, 2026, Frommeyer shared a post on her X (formerly Twitter) account: "https://t.co/zlDX39WABv".
The following day, August 24, 2026, she invited followers to attend an event in Augusta supporting Mike Fisher’s campaign for Kentucky State Representative. In her post, she stated, "Join me in Augusta to support Mike Fisher for KY State Representative! Strong leadership matters for our communities, and I’m honored to join former Bracken Co. Judge Executive Earl Bush as a special guest for an evening supporting Mike’s campaign. Come out, connect, and let’s https://t.co/ZI7cEe6kUf".
On August 25, 2026, Frommeyer announced her participation at the Kentucky State Fair. She wrote, "I am honored to be sharing a few words at the Kentucky State Fair this Thursday, August 27, for a special Kentucky Right to Life press conference. We will be gathering to recognize the incredible legislators, first responders, and community leaders who make Safe Haven Baby Boxes https://t.co/0l4FsslEyR".
Frommeyer is known for her involvement in state politics and advocacy work within Kentucky. The Safe Haven Baby Boxes program mentioned in her post provides resources and anonymous safe surrender options for infants in crisis situations.
